aiReadyLines.text: Unit Four : People Who Make a Difference 35
“Mine to keep just for a little while,
To teach him how to be gentle and kind,
To train and direct his dear little mind,
To help him live by every rule
And get the best he can from school.”
“Whose child is this?” I ask once more,
Just as the little one entered the door.
said the parent and the teacher as they smiled,
And cach took the hand of the little child.
“Qurs to love and train together
Ours this blessed task forever.” [Anonymous]

to bathe = to wash
to train= to teach
blessed = noble
